cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.10)
project(core CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
file(GLOB SOURCES "*.cpp")
add_library(core STATIC ${SOURCES})

install(TARGETS core ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
